prompt: Create an ultra-realistic cinematic studio portrait of an adult Black man in his late 20s seated confidently in a premium black leather armchair against a deep matte-black studio background. The subject faces the camera directly with a calm, composed, professional expression, short neatly trimmed black hair, clean-shaven face, and natural skin texture. Dress him in a crisp white long-sleeve dress shirt, fitted black waistcoat, slim black necktie, black dress trousers, and a silver metal wristwatch with a black round dial on his right wrist. Pose: relaxed but authoritative, torso angled slightly toward camera, right forearm resting on the chair arm with the hand near his lap, left arm relaxed with the hand resting on the seat edge, legs casually apart. Use a medium three-quarter seated crop from upper thighs to head, centered composition, portrait orientation. Lighting should be high-end studio photography: soft key light from front-left, gentle fill on the face, subtle rim separation, controlled highlights on the leather chair, and smooth falloff into the black background. Make the image look like a premium executive portrait shot with a professional full-frame camera, sharp facial detail, realistic fabric folds, glossy leather texture, shallow depth of field, natural color grading, no visible logos, no text, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张超写实的电影质感摄影棚肖像，主体为 一位 20 多岁的成年黑人男性，他自信地坐在一张高级黑色皮质扶手椅上，背景为深邃的哑光黑摄影棚背景。主体直视镜头，表情冷静、沉稳且专业，留着修剪整齐的短黑发，面部剃须干净，皮肤纹理自然。让他身穿一件挺括的白色长袖衬衫、合身的黑色马甲、修身黑色领带、黑色西裤，右手佩戴一块黑色圆表盘的银色金属腕表。姿势：放松但具有权威感，躯干略微朝向镜头，右前臂搁在椅扶手上，手靠近大腿，左臂放松，手搁在座椅边缘，双腿自然分开。采用从大腿上部到头部的中景四分之三构图，居中构图，竖向肖像。灯光应采用高端摄影棚布光：左前方柔和的主光，面部有柔和的补光，微妙的轮廓光分离，皮椅上有受控的高光，并平滑地过渡到黑色背景中。使图像看起来像是由专业全画幅相机拍摄的高级高管肖像，面部细节清晰，织物褶皱真实，皮革质感光泽，浅景深，自然色彩分级，无可见 Logo，无文字，无水印。
